name: koalafix-auto
description: Makes KoalaFix automatic in Claude Code and Cowork: the team brief at session start, recall on each prompt, work in progress started and closed for you, sign-in through the browser on first use. In Claude Code it installs the koalafix plugin with it; on claude.ai and in Cowork, add koalafix too. Needs Node.js 22 or later on the machine.
